profile.name: Apple Inc.
profile.description: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company that specializes in consumer electronics, computer software, and online services. Apple is the world's largest technology company by revenue (totalling $274.5 billion in 2020) and, since January 2021, the world's most valuable company. As of 2021, Apple is the world's fourth-largest PC vendor by unit sales, and fourth-largest smartphone manufacturer. It is one of the Big Five American information technology companies, along with Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Facebook.

jarvis_take: Apple’s 69.8 score points to a solid but not unqualified outlook, with medium confidence. Quality (84.6) and momentum (77.9) are the strongest supports: iPhone revenue rose 17% and Mac revenue 24% in the September quarter, with positive year-over-year growth in four of four quarters. The main constraints are valuation (51.3) and modest revenue acceleration; at a $5.17 trillion market capitalization, upside is uncertain, and incremental profits from AI and new products have not been quantified.
what_changed: The score rose from 66.9 to 69.8, led by a 20.3-point improvement in momentum. Growth fell 7 points, including a 15.3-point decline in Revenue Acceleration.
what_would_change_score: Evidence that Duo, Siri AI, Services and new Macs are generating material incremental revenue and profit could strengthen the outlook. A forward valuation measure and clearer evidence on product margins, supply constraints and regulatory risks would help assess whether the current market capitalization leaves room for attractive returns.
